newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada pension take could fall if stocks did well.
newsitem.headline: Canada pension take could fall if stocks did well.

text.p: Future Canadian governments would probably reduce Canada Pension Plan (CPP) premiums if the funds invested in stock markets performed better than expected, Finance Minister Paul Martin said on Wednesday.

Martin announced last month an increase of about 70 percent in CPP premiums and said the plan would be able to invest in stock and bond markets to give it a better return and better fund it as baby boomers moved toward retirement.
They are currently invested only in provincial bonds at lower than market rates.
